Client set-up › Structure — the agreed order

Drawn from the real step on the worked example (top level “Group”, pillar word “Pillars”). Left: today. Right: proposed.

  • Titles (version 2): each card's name is its header now: bold, a bit bigger, on a shaded band, with its On/Off on the right. The lines “The group plans its own”, “This client has them / has one” and “Part of the group's plan” are gone.
  • Order: Top level → [company pillars | company capabilities] → Second layer → Functions → [Third layer | Independent capabilities].
  • Planned on the company: the second card is on, its two halves side by side. The capabilities half has no first or second section, only its plan. The bottom pair is off, one card, one line each saying why.
  • Planned on the units: the second card is off (one line each), and the bottom two are on.
  • Capabilities live in one place at a time: in the company plan (second card) or as their own layer (bottom), never both.
  • One question for you: when the bottom two are both ON they are each a full layer (three sections), and side by side they get too squeezed to read. So I drew them one under the other when on, and side by side only when off.
  • Not in this drawing: the owner and custodian on each direction and capability, and who may fill in what. That is the next piece, with its own mockup.
